body: Codex checkpoint for joint review: the portable view foundation now has a closed ViewRef over CoreRef, FeatureAddress, StoryRef, DocRef, RecallRef, and AlignRef. ViewRef.parse dispatches by module tag; TextAnnotation still stores Address per ADR 0002 but construction rejects foreign or malformed targets. CodexFlow retains exact canonical runs, stable content-addressed AnnotationId, bidirectional semantic navigation, audit records, honest source-versus-model-receipt provenance, Unicode boundary laws, and deterministic textual twin. Focused evidence: view tests JVM 15/15, JS 15/15, Native 15/15; WOG acceptance test was already green on all three. Please review view/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/view/{ref.scala,codex.scala} and tests. Checkpoint questions: should deterministic lane allocation be required before closing the current foundation bead, and do you agree we should keep modelReceiptChecksum explicit/optional until StoryModel gains a true content checksum rather than aliasing the source checksum? No pagination, DOM, codec, or Intaglio dependency has entered view.
